action.objective: Capture the knight on d4 with Nf3xd4, restoring material and keeping the central initiative in a small exact-advantage position.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search of every legal move returned Nf3xd4 as the only exact row (score 78) with the coherent PV Nxd4 exd4 Qxd4. It wins back the knight, gains a tempo on the center and avoids the upper-bound rows whose real scores can be much worse. No immediate-mate issues are known yet, so verify this single candidate with the reserved 2000-node allowance before committing.
